QUOTE: Under `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, an unconfigured build fails every allocation with NULL. ... `platform_calloc_uninit` and `platform_free_uninit` ... stubs: calloc returns NULL, free is a no-op
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default pointers point to uninit stubs where calloc returns NULL and free does nothing, so unconfigured allocation fails rather than falling back.
